meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以驱动真实浏览器：打开网址、读取页面元素、执行点击和输入文字等操作；也能截图、录屏、导出 PDF。它会先获取页面可交互元素，再按引用操作。
howto.when: 当用户要浏览网站、在网页上点击或填表、截图等需要操作浏览器的任务时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com，然后把整页截图保存下来
say.note: 会打开网页，执行整页截图并保存到文件

say.text: 登录页帮我填用户名和密码，再点登录按钮
say.note: 会定位输入框和按钮完成表单提交

say.text: 列出这个页面所有可点击的按钮和链接
say.note: 会生成可交互元素清单及标识

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can drive a real browser: open URLs, read page elements, click and type, take screenshots, record video, and export PDF. It first snapshots interactive elements, then acts by reference.
howto.when_en: Activated when the user needs to browse a site, click or fill elements, take screenshots, extract data, or test web apps — tasks that require actual browser automation.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves the screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill the username and password on the login page and click Sign In.
say_en.note: Locates the inputs and submits the form.

say_en.text: List all clickable buttons and links on this page.
say_en.note: Produces a list of interactive elements with refs.
